dct_description_sm:
This dataset includes all of the voting places available to voters for the 2011 general election.

Prior to the 2014 municipal election, the city was divided into voting divisions and voters were required to vote at a designated voting place within their assigned voting division.

The City of Vancouver now uses a Vote-Anywhere model. Voters can vote at any voting place within the City.

The City operates an at-large voting system.

Note:

UBC Lands and UEL residents are only eligible to vote for School Trustees.

Data accuracy

Some attribute names may change from election to election and are not directly comparable over time.

Data currency

These are the voting places used for the City's 2011 municipal elections during Advance Voting and on General Voting Day.

Websites for further information

  • Municipal election results
  • Voting division boundaries (applicable only for municipal elections prior to 2014)
